title: Fully Customisable
subtitle: Flexible options for layouts, navigation, animation, media, events, and custom integrations.

title: Touch and Drag Support
subtitle: Touch dragging for mobile interfaces and mouse dragging for desktop browsers.

title: Fully Responsive
subtitle: Breakpoint-based settings adapt item counts and carousel behavior to the available width.

title: Modern Browsers
subtitle: Hardware-accelerated CSS transitions with prebuilt JavaScript and stylesheets.

title: jQuery Compatibility
subtitle: Tested with jQuery 1.8.3, 2.2.4, 3.7.1, and 4.0.0, with and without jQuery Migrate.

title: Modules and Plugins
subtitle: Use the included plugins or create custom plugins through Owl Carousel's modular architecture.
